summary: Example task runs show version on CNOS with community.network.cnos_command.
questions: How do I get the CNOS version with Ansible?

answer_card.title: Get CNOS version
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Retrieve CNOS OS version
  community.network.cnos_command:
    commands: show version
  when: ansible_network_os == 'community.network.cnos'
```
